1. DEFINITE STATUS
The terms and conditions of this agreement will remain confidential to all the above-named parties.
2. RATES
2.1. All rates in this agreement are quoted in US Dollars as per the rate card and are inclusive of
Government taxes and are net and non-commissionable, unless otherwise stated by Kempinski
Hotels in Kenya to the Company. However, the Kempinski Hotels in Kenya reserves the right to
amend the rates to reflect any increase in operational costs, or any new or increased taxes or levies.
2.2. Rates quoted include:
Includes: full board accommodation, soft drinks, beer and house-wine and non-luxury spirits, shared
day and evening game drives, guided bush walk, bush meals (daytime experience), and return
airstrip transfers from Olkiombo and Olare Orok airstrip only.
Excludes: Masai Mara Game Reserve Park Entrance Fees, Olare Motorogi Conservancy fee,
Cultural Visits, Champagne and Luxury Spirits, and any other expenses of personal nature
2.3. These rates are for the use of bona fide customers travelling on an individual basis for leisure
purposes and are not applicable to groups (10 rooms and above), trade missions, exhibition
delegates or corporate/business travellers.
2.4 These rates may not be exposed in any form of publication and moreover have to be hidden in
packages and/or tours.

2.5 Should clients wish to extend their stay beyond the period originally booked and confirmed by the
Company, Kempinski Hotels in Kenya will apply the Best Available Rate for the extended period,
unless the accommodation extension request is channelled through the Company.
2.6 Rates, validity and applicable markets for the Hotel, are contained in this agreement in Page 8 and 9.
3. RESERVATION
3.1. BOOKINGS
3.1.1. All bookings need to be sent on a sell and report basis.
3.1.2. Only the room type confirmed by the Hotel will be offered to the guest.
3.1.3. Should the guest request a higher room category to the one initially booked, then relevant
surcharge applies.
3.1.4. Booking confirmation needs to state:
• Surname, first name of the guest and any sharers
• Age of children (if applicable)
• Number and category of reserved rooms
• Arrival and Departure Dates
• Country of origin
• Partner Agency or Tour Operator generating the booking.
1. DOUBLE BOOKINGS
In the case that Kempinski Hotels in Kenya has sufficient reason to believe that a potential double booking
may occur, due to an existing booking with same or similar booking details (name, number of rooms and
dates) via a third party source, the Hotel may reject any new booking requests with the same booking details,
even if from allotment, until the existing booking via a third party has been cancelled.
2. MINIMUM AGE
Minimum age of 06 years or above is required for a stay at the camp.
II. TURNAWAY
4.1 In the unlikely event that Kempinski Hotels in Kenya must turn away a guest with a confirmed and
complete reservation, Kempinski Hotels in Kenya will be responsible to arrange accommodation for
the guest in a similar category property.
4.2 Courtesy transfer will be arranged, and the guest will be granted a phone call of up to three (3)
minutes, a one (1) page fax to any destination in the world or a 15-minute Internet usage (e-mail).
4.3 Arrangements will also be made to bring back the guest to the Hotel/Camp.
5 CLOSE-OUT & STOP SELL PERIODS
Kempinski Hotels in Kenya reserves the right to update with close out dates or stop sell as deemed
necessary.

6 MARKETING
6.1 Kempinski Hotels in Kenya must approve its inclusion prior to printing or publishing of any form of
material for distribution through any channels including brochures, catalogues, flyers and websites or
in any other marketing related activities.
6.2 In the event of the Company failing to forward the proposed form and content for review and approval
prior to printing or publishing of the brochure and other publicity materials which may result in
misrepresentation. Kempinski Hotels in Kenya will not be liable to the guest, to the retail agency or
the Company for any damages, costs or claims arising from such misrepresentation. Furthermore,
this negligence may result in Kempinski Hotels in Kenya declining any business sourcing from such
activities and immediately invalidating any existing agreement with the Company.
6.3 Kindly use exclusively the material provided by the Kempinski Hotels in Kenya. All photographs,
images or logos used for any promotional material have to be in line with the standard format
according to the corporate identity of Kempinski (therefore, these images should not be edited or
altered except for minimising or maximising their size).
6.4 Photographs can be downloaded from the following image library on
https://kempinski.picturepark.com/Site/Start or can alternatively be provided on email in high
resolution format upon request.
6.5 To maintain the corporate standards of Kempinski Hotels, the Company has to ensure that the
Kempinski Hotels in Kenya is always listed by its full title and that it is rated as five-star deluxe
property without exceptions.
6.6 New copies of the brochures/promotional literature should be delivered as soon as they are available
to the Company, but in any event no later than one month prior to the launch of the programme.
7 ONLINE RATE PUBLISHING
7.1 Rates are confidential and are not to be disclosed directly to the consumer. Furthermore, they may
only be used to form the basis of a package.
7.2 To qualify as an online package, room rates must be sold and promoted as part of a product which
includes other elements such as fares of selected airline partners and ground transportation.
7.3 The Company may not sell the contracted net rates without packaging on any consumer Internet
website or Global Distribution System, neither directly nor via a secondary agent (vendor, wholesaler,
distributor), unless prior approval has been granted in writing by Kempinski Hotels in Kenya. The
contracted Company is deemed responsible for the selling practices of the secondary agents.
8 CHILD POLICY
• Olare Mara Kempinski Masai Mara
Children aged below 6 years are not encouraged at the Olare Mara Kempinski.
• One child aged 6 – 12 years sharing with two adults pay 50% of per adult sharing rate per night.
• Two children 6 – 12 years sharing in own tent each pay 75% of adult sharing rate.
• One child 6 – 12 years sharing with one adult, will be charged as double room.
• Children aged 13 years and above are considered as adults and therefore pay full adult rates.

10 PAYMENT & CREDIT
10.1 General Terms
• All reservations are payable; 14 days prior to date of arrival for Low/Shoulder Season, 60
days prior to date of arrival for High Season unless credit facilities are in place.
• In the event of payment not received in advance, Kempinski Hotels in Kenya reserve right to
collect such payment from the guest directly upon check-out, at the Best Available Rate.
• Credit facilities need the individual Hotels approval and invoices need to be paid within 30
days of check-out.
• Where a Company arranges payment to the Hotel through a third party, the Company shall
remain responsible for such accounts until full payment has been received by the Hotel.
• The Company shall agree to assist the Hotel to compensate any and all damages incurred to
the failure of the guest to pay to the Hotel service.
• Delay in payment may result in suspension or withdrawal of credit facilities.
• CONFIRMED voucher/s for Olare Mara Kempinski will only be issued once 100% payment
has been made within 14days of booking, unless otherwise stated within a binding contract.
10.2 Payment Terms for Olare Mara Kempinski
• A deposit should be received within 7 days after the invoice is sent. Minimum deposit is 20%
of the invoice amount.
• Full payment should be received at least.
- 14 days prior to date of arrival for Low/Shoulder Season.
- 60 days prior to date of arrival for High Season.
• Confirmation vouchers will only be issued once full payment has been received, unless
otherwise stated in writing.
11 TERMINATION OF CONTRACT
11.1 One month notice will be given.
11.2 The termination of this agreement does not liberate the Company from any prior payment
commitments to the agreement.
12 LIABILITY & INDEMNITY
12.1 The Company shall ensure that guests accept and agree with any terms and conditions in this
agreement that relate to them and in addition to Kempinski Hotels in Kenya terms, conditions, rules and
procedures.
12.2 The Company shall agree to assist Kempinski Hotels in Kenya to compensate any and all
damages incurred to the failure of the guest to pay to the Hotels service.

13 GENERAL TERMS
13.1 Neither party shall be under any obligation to the other hereunder if performance thereof is
rendered impossible due to an event of force majeure, being an event which the affected party/parties
could not reasonably foresee and the effect of which was beyond the control of the party/parties
affected (excluding settlement of payments) which shall include, but without limitation to, acts of God,
war, strikes, epidemics, earthquake, fire or flood.
13.2 Advice, recommendations or opinions by members of staff of the Hotel are given and expressed
in good faith and shall not constitute representation of any description, neither give rise to any claim
against the Hotel or such representatives.
13.3 The construction, validity and performance of this agreement shall be governed by the laws of
and applicable in the Hotel territory. The parties agree to submit to the Courts of the respective
territory for the purpose of resolving any disputes under or arising out of this agreement.
13.4 Kempinski Hotels in Kenya reserves the right to terminate this agreement at any time, without
prejudice to any other rights it may have, in the event that the Company fails to comply with this
agreement. Termination of the agreement shall be effected by Kempinski Hotels in Kenya notifying
the Company in writing of such termination (at its address stated above or another address notified by
the Company to the Hotel with registered delivery).
13.5 Failure of the Hotel to enforce at any time the provisions of this agreement shall not be construed
as a waiver of any rights nor affect the validity of the agreement nor prejudice the Hotel as regards to
subsequent action.
13.6 The Company shall sell rooms to end users or to any Affiliates, agents or any other third party
contractors, at a recommended rate of at least 20% above the net FIT rate.
13.7 The Company is responsible for the selling practices of any and all of its Affiliates, agents or other
third party contractors.
13.8 The Company shall only make rates and inventory available to Affiliates that have been
made aware to Kempinski Hotels in Kenya. Such a list will be communicated to the Hotel in advance.
13.9 “Best Available Rate” means the lowest unrestricted rate for rooms, inclusive of any taxes, that is
offered to end users by Kempinski Hotels in Kenya.
13.10 The Company shall not, nor shall it allow its Affiliates, to perform keyword bidding on web search
engines using the brand name “Kempinski” or the Hotel’s brand name (in whole or in part) or any
trade name or trademark which belongs to Kempinski or its Affiliates or any variations of such names,
without written approval by Kempinski Hotels in Kenya.
13.11 The Company shall not, nor shall it allow its Affiliates to, carry out any form of URL grabbing
which incorporates the word “Kempinski” or any Hotel brand name (in whole or in part) or any trade
name or trademark which belongs to Kempinski or its Affiliates or any variation of such words or
names.
13.12 In the event Hotels or one of its Affiliates enters into a group-level agreement with The Company
and the Hotel participates in the group-level agreement, this agreement shall terminate automatically
as of the date the group-level agreement and Hotel’s participation begin.
13.13 In order to validate this agreement, a signed copy of the same (as well as each page initialled,
including the rate sheet) has to be returned to the Hotel within 30 days from the date of issue.

4 BOOKING TERMS AND CONDITIONS:
4.1 Bookings will only be confirmed on condition of the following Terms:
▪ A booking voucher from a Travel Agent/Tour Operator will be required to reserve space or room.
▪ All details relevant to booking must be mentioned therein. These include Booking Dates, Guest
Name, Type of Accommodation required, Number of Guests, Arrival & Departure details and
Dates, any special requirements, allergies if any, disabilities if any, Children in group as well as
ages.
▪ Please ensure that when a booking has been confirmed by us, you receive a CONFIRMED
stamped voucher, unless otherwise WAITLISTED or CANCELLED.
4.2 Provisional Bookings:
▪ Provisional booking requests must be done in writing via email.
▪ Upon receipt of an inquiry the booking will be held provisionally for 07 days.
▪ Upon expiry of the provisional period the rooms will be automatically released.
▪ Rebooking will be subject to room availability.
4.3 Confirmed Bookings:
▪ Confirmation of must be done in writing via email with an attached booking voucher.
▪ The hotel will confirm the booking by sending a invoice for payment processing.
▪ A deposit should be received within 7 days after the invoice is sent. Minimum deposit is 20% of
the invoice amount.
5 CANCELLATIONS & NO SHOWS
5.1 All bookings requiring cancellation, must be advised in writing. Cancellations are only accepted on
written advice.
5.2 Reservation held without a deposit by Kempinski hotels where no deposit has been paid or guarantee
has been given will be cancelled by Kempinski hotels.
5.3 Please find cancellation Terms outlined below:
Olare Mara Kempinski
In the event of cancellations after confirmation, the following cancellation fee will be applicable.
This fee will be a percentage of the total estimated charges and will be calculated on a sliding scale.
Shoulder/ Low Season
• 0 – 7 Days /NO SHOW 100% cancellation fee applies
• 8 – 14 Days: 35% cancellation fee applies
• 15 – 35 Days: 20% cancellation fee applies
High Season
• 0 – 60 Days / NO SHOW100% cancellation fee applies
• 61 - 90 Days: 35% cancellation fee applies
